units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 47:20">Targ. Y. Gen. XLVII, 20</cite>.
Targ. Y. Deut. XXI, 5 למִחְלוֹט, v. Af.

senses.gloss: to sell irredeemably, to forfeit. Y. Pes. IV, 31ᵇ bot. ולא יְחַלְּטוּן בניהון that they might not forfeit their pledged children. Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᶜ bot. [read:] בגין דלא תְחַלְּטוּן … בידן that you might not surrender the government to their (the Samaritans’) hands. Y. Keth. IX, 33ᵇ bot. אנן מְחַלְּטִין וכ׳ we shall declare their property forfeited.
units: <cite ref="Arakhin 31b:71">Arakh. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>ולחַלְּטֵיה הקדש</he> let the sacred treasury be declared its permanent owner; a. e.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 13:11">Targ. Y. Lev. XIII, 11</cite>.—Part. pass. <he>מַחְלַט</he>, f. <he>מַחְלְטָא</he>.
<cite ref="Arakhin 32b:6">Arakh. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>וירושלים מי מִיחֲלַט בה</he> are buildings in Jerusalem ever irredeemable?
